title.en: The sleepwalking scene and Lady Macbeth's end

body.en: A doctor and a gentlewoman watch Lady Macbeth walk in her sleep, carrying a candle (she now fears the dark), rubbing her hands as if to wash off blood that will not go, and recalling the murders of Duncan, Banquo and Lady Macduff in broken speech. The woman who once thought a little water would clear them is destroyed by guilt; the doctor says she needs a priest more than a physician. Later her death is reported, and it is suggested she took her own life.

points.en: She tries to wash away imagined blood
Her guilt breaks out in fragments
Her death is reported, possibly suicide

text.en: Guilt
Lady Macbeth sleepwalks and
relives the murders.
Isolation
Macbeth's thanes desert him; he clings
to the prophecies in Dunsinane.
Despair
News of the queen's death: Macbeth
sees life as meaningless.
Climax
Birnam Wood moves; Macduff reveals

Restoration
Malcolm is hailed king; order and
justice return to Scotland.

say.en: Move along the plot of Act V. Each stage shows what happens there, in our own words; the height of the curve is the tension.

body.en: Deserted by his thanes and with an army closing in, Macbeth swings between despair and defiance, trusting the prophecies. When told of his wife's death he reflects that life is a meaningless, empty show, a sign of how hollow his gains have become. When Birnam Wood seems to move, and when Macduff reveals his birth, Macbeth knows the Witches tricked him with double meanings, yet he refuses to yield and dies fighting. Malcolm closes the play by calling the dead pair a butcher and his fiend-like queen and promising to restore order. Shakespeare leaves us both condemning and pitying the tragic hero.

problem.en: How is the theme of appearance and reality completed in Act V?

steps.en: The prophecies that appeared to promise safety turn out to mean defeat.
Birnam Wood appears to move, but it is soldiers carrying branches.
Macduff appears to be an ordinary man, but his birth fulfils the prophecy.
Lady Macbeth's outward strength is revealed as hollow by her sleepwalking.

answer.en: Every appearance in Act V gives way to a deadly reality.
